notes: Yellow-green painted concrete industrial loft: four pilasters with capitals, frieze panels at the parapet, steel-sash multi-pane windows in three groups above, three tall shop windows with multi-pane transoms and louvred bulkheads, iron-gated entry at the right end. Dark sage-grey, low saturation. Milky pale shop glass (was an opaque tan-reading shell), dark olive slim storefront members, a deeper moulded parapet band, heavier pilasters, a blank blue leasing board inside the middle window. Storefront members on a painted-white base with an olive tint (a tint on painted-steel only darkens it to black). Smooth painted cast stone (cast-stone-trim) in a lighter, less saturated sage with a darker base plinth; no pilaster flutes; moulded spandrel squares; weathering without streak columns; reflection-dominant glass (glassModel). Smooth painted stucco (sage kept), pale blue-grey frosted ground-floor glass, darker reflective uppers, no streak weathering. Pale celery / lime-cream paint (the sage read dark blue-green along the street). Multi-pane steel shopfronts (0.6 m panes), opaque pale blue-grey shop glass (frosted read as a lit white room), no blue plaque. Yellow-green (celery read cream), flat pilasters without capitals (read classical). 3 storeys over the shop. LiDAR 7.5 m allows 2 - needs a dossier. Paler yellow-green (read lime). Street grime: soot at the base, grime, faint wide streaks. Olive/khaki-green deco (mid olive, not cream); the right end is a wide black iron-gated bay.
